question: What is the language and flavor text of the card that has colorpie watermark? List out the type of this card.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T2.language, T2.flavorText FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'colorpie'
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T2.language, T2.flavorText FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'colorpie'

c.request:
What is the language and flavor text of the card that has colorpie watermark? List out the type of this card.
Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
c.sql: SELECT fd.language, fd.flavorText, c.type FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'colorpie'

b.request: For the card(s) with the colorpie watermark, list the language and flavor text from foreign_data (keeping cards that have no matching foreign_data record, via a left join from cards) along with the card's type
b.sql: SELECT fd.language, fd.flavorText, c.type FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'colorpie'

d.request: What are the language and flavor text of the card that has the colorpie watermark, and what is its type? Include the card even if it has no matching foreign_data record (i.e., keep rows with no matching foreign_data record).
d.sql: SELECT f.language, f.flavorText, c.type FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'colorpie'
